firstPartyEvidence.finding: Session price is fixed by the host; some hosts use variable amounts including duration.
Tariffs are defined and vary by charging network; exact tariffs are shown on charge points/app/map.
Multiple tariff IDs/models are published (energy-only and energy+duration), proving no single national EV MAP price.
TPE flow asks user to verify the tariff proposed for the selected charge point.

testedConclusion: No deterministic historical station/EVSE -> current host tariff ID mapping recovered from public first-party surfaces. No national extrapolation is safe.
reopenCondition: Exact EV MAP app/QR/TPE/API station or EVSE mapping to the current host tariff, or authoritative producer/AFIR/QualiCharge tariff text tied to exact EVSE.
